Players Committee card image of [[Apology Accepted (V)]] (original printing), game text: “During battle, lose an Imperial leader piloting your Star Destroyer. For remainder of turn, that Star Destroyer draws 2 battle destiny if unable to otherwise, is immune to attrition, and its power may not be increased by Imperial pilots aboard (except Vader).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/apologyaccepted.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
